name: application-code-language-tabs
title: Code Language Tabs
description: Tabbed code-snippet panel components for switching between request languages or package managers, with a copy action.
useWhen: Tabbed code-snippet panel components for switching between request languages or package managers, with a copy action.
avoidWhen: Avoid code language tabs when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Code Language Tabs uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
